notes: Each fare cell is keyed by a canonical unordered pair of endpoint PVPs.
Both travel directions reuse the same two prices: Mon-Thu and Fri-Sun.
Accepted PVP chains are evidence that the selected route traverses the span; runtime never sums PVP fares.
Different spans require different cells; a longer span cannot reuse a shorter span's price.
